title: See missing documentation by area
statement: As a developer preparing a change for review, I can see each documentation coverage area and its exact gaps so I can complete the relevant documentation without reducing everything to one score.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Status reports implementation, stories, personas, design, quality, and health as separate named areas with their covered and uncovered entries.
For each accepted criterion, prototype, UX, UI, technical, quality, and implementation each resolve to linked, excluded, or gap, and every gap names its reasons.
